chains.notes: The continuity chain — never retired. Uncontrolled by design; its overlap with the measurement chain is the bias-estimation dataset.

chains.label: miniDSP UMIK-1 → USB → voice-journey-capture WAV 48k/24
chains.notes: era.start is set by the first real session. Before first capture: download the per-serial calibration file from miniDSP (it stays outside Git; its path is configuration on the host, never in this registry), set the UMIK as the input device and the input-volume slider once; voice-journey-capture records the pinned level with each session. Re-pinning later is a logged era event, not a casual act.
